scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic; finite experiments corroborate only. Previously known mean and second moment are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Four independently uniform side fractions on any parallelogram; not general quadrilaterals or unstratified perimeter sampling. Weak conditional limit, not finite-threshold Dirichlet equality; independent validation outstanding.
title: Universal area density and marked extreme-area law for four-side random quadrilaterals
